main_text.p: הֵימֶנּוּ Ab eo, הֵימֶנָּה Ab ea.
הֵינוֹ Id est, Hoc est, Illud est: Vocabulum compositum ex verbo הֵיא Est, & Affixo נוֹ, quod etiam est in Hebraeo יִשְׁנוֹ, & יִלְכְּדָנוֹ Prov.5.22. הֵינוֹ הָךְ Idipsum est.
הָךְ Hic, Huc: gen. comm. idem quod זֶה, זאת.
הָכָא Hic, Huc: repetitum in sententia continuata, Hic; Illic.
הָכִי Sic, Ita: אֲפִילּוּ הָכִי Et si ita fit: אֲדְהָכִי Interim.
הָלָא, הְלָא: Cum Lamed semper. הָלָא לְהָלָא Ultra, Ulterius; Illuc, Hierosolymitanè לְהָלָן. Ex Hebraeo הָלְאוֹ contractum sine dubio.
הָלוּאִי הַלּוּאִי Utinam. Plerumq; sequi solet ו aut ד.

הָלַךְ Ire; Ambulare; Hebr. הֲלָכָה Expositio sive Lectio ex Gemara. In his disputationibus multa sunt, quae per oralem traditionem inde à Mose usque accepta, de quibus dicunt, הֲלָכָה לְמֹשֶׁה מִסִּינַי Expositio Mosis à monte Sinai. הלכתא Via, Iter, Ambulatio, Incessus, Mos, Consuetudo, Ritus, Ratio.
הָלְכָּא Huc, videtur esse pro לְהָכָא.
לְהָלָן הַלָּן Illic, Ibi: Ultra, Ulterius.
הֵן Si: repetitum in sententia continuata est Sive, ut Dan.3. v.7. Esra 7.26. Apud Rabbinos quandoque est affirmantis; Ita, Etiam, Est: cujus oppositum לֹא Non. Scribitur & הֵין;
הָנֵי Isti, Ista: הָנֵי כֻלֵּי Ista verba, Ista res: הָנֵי הָךְ Ista ipsa. הֵינוֹ הָנֵי הוּא Illud, Idem est, idem quod paulò ante הָךְ הָנֵי.
הָנָּה, הָנְאָ Commodum, Utilitatem percipere, vel afferre; Prodesse, Lucrari. נֶהֱנָה Idem. הֲנָאָה Utilitas, Commodum, Lucrum.

page.notes: Hebrew letter printed alone at the top centre (ה): a section or gathering mark, not a running head, so left out. Hebrew vowel points are read approximately; doubtful pointing and some Hebrew forms (e.g. לְהָכָא, חֵמֶנוּ, הָנְאָ) could not be checked letter by letter and may be misread. Page number at top right. Show-through and the digitiser's watermark at the foot are omitted.
